note: Re-judged 2026-10-30 (independent auditor) after the user-namespace conversion (d8427e4380): the TestGatewayICMPEchoReply unit gained only `if !userns.Enter(t) { return }` as its first statement and its build tag moved from integration&&linux to linux. userns.Enter (internal/test/userns/userns_linux.go) re-runs the one named test in a fresh user+net+mount namespace and returns false to the parent only when the child reported PASS or SKIP; a failing child, a non-zero exit, or a child that ran nothing calls t.Fatalf, so every assertion below the guard still fails the test when the behaviour breaks. Body otherwise byte-identical. RFC 792 Echo: "To form an echo reply message, the source and destination addresses are simply reversed, the type code changed to 0, and the checksum recomputed." Fresh judgement: reversed addresses, Type 0 and a verifying checksum on the reply, and the secondary-address request must be answered from .253 to the requester, never from the primary .254. Enforced.
